theory_html:
A. I have to do something = it is necessary for me to do it

A. I have to do something = tôi cần phải làm, bắt buộc phải làm

  • ‘This is my medicine. I have to take it three times a day.’

    ‘Đây là thuốc của tôi. Tôi phải uống ba lần một ngày.’

I have to do something = it is necessary for me to do it, I am obliged to do it: I / we / you / they have to do / work / go / wear etc.; he / she / it has to do / work / go / wear etc.

I have to do something = tôi cần phải làm, bắt buộc phải làm: I / we / you / they have to do / work / go / wear v.v.; he / she / it has to do / work / go / wear v.v.

  • I’ll be late for work tomorrow. I have to go to the dentist.

    Mai tôi sẽ đi làm muộn. Tôi phải đi nha sĩ.

  • Jane starts work at 7 o’clock, so she has to get up at 6.

    Jane bắt đầu làm lúc 7 giờ, nên cô ấy phải dậy lúc 6 giờ.

  • You have to pass a test before you can get a driving licence.

    Bạn phải đỗ một bài thi trước khi được cấp bằng lái.

B. had to for the past

B. had to cho quá khứ

The past (yesterday / last week etc.) is had to …:

Quá khứ (yesterday / last week v.v.) là had to …:

  • I was late for work yesterday. I had to go to the dentist.

    Hôm qua tôi đi làm muộn. Tôi đã phải đi nha sĩ.

  • We had to walk home last night. There were no buses.

    Tối qua chúng tôi phải đi bộ về nhà. Không có xe buýt.

C. Questions and negatives: do/does/did … have to

C. Câu hỏi và phủ định: do/does/did … have to

In questions and negatives we use do / does (present) and did (past):

Trong câu hỏi và phủ định dùng do / does (hiện tại) và did (quá khứ):

question
câu hỏi		negative
phủ định
present
hiện tại		do I / we / you / they have to …? / does he / she / it have to …?I / we / you / they don’t have to … / he / she / it doesn’t have to …
past
quá khứ		did I / we / you / they / he / she / it have to …?I / we / you / they / he / she / it didn’t have to …

  • What time do you have to go to the dentist tomorrow?

    Mai mấy giờ bạn phải đi nha sĩ?

  • Does Jane have to work on Sundays?

    Jane có phải làm việc Chủ nhật không?

  • Why did they have to leave the party early?

    Tại sao họ phải rời bữa tiệc sớm?

I don’t have to (do something) = it is not necessary to do it:

I don’t have to (do something) = không cần thiết phải làm:

  • I’m not working tomorrow, so I don’t have to get up early.

    Mai tôi không làm việc, nên tôi không phải dậy sớm.

  • Ian doesn’t have to work very hard. He’s got an easy job.

    Ian không phải làm việc vất vả. Anh ấy có công việc nhàn.

  • We didn’t have to wait very long for the bus – it came in a few minutes.

    Chúng tôi không phải đợi xe buýt lâu – vài phút là xe đến.

D. must and have to

D. must và have to

You can use must or have to when you say what you think is necessary, when you give your opinion:

Có thể dùng must hoặc have to khi nói điều mình cho là cần thiết, khi nêu ý kiến cá nhân:

  • It’s a fantastic film. You must see it. or You have to see it.

    Phim hay tuyệt. Bạn phải xem nó.

When you are not giving your personal opinion, use have to (not must). Compare:

Khi không phải ý kiến cá nhân, dùng have to (không dùng must). So sánh:

  • Jane won’t be at work this afternoon. She has to go to the doctor. (this is not my personal opinion – it is a fact)

    Chiều nay Jane không đi làm. Cô ấy phải đi khám bác sĩ. (không phải ý kiến của tôi – đó là sự thật)

  • Jane isn’t well. She doesn’t want to go to the doctor, but I told her she must go. (this is my personal opinion)

    Jane không khỏe. Cô ấy không muốn đi khám, nhưng tôi bảo cô ấy phải đi. (đây là ý kiến cá nhân của tôi)

mcq.question: This is my medicine. I ___ it three times a day.
mcq.full: This is my medicine. I have to take it three times a day.
mcq.vi: Đây là thuốc của tôi. Tôi phải uống ba lần một ngày.
mcq.expl:
have to / has to + infinitive = it is necessary, I am obliged to do it.
have to / has to + nguyên mẫu = cần phải, bắt buộc phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: I → have to + nguyên mẫu.
mcq.key: This is my medicine. I ___ it three times a day.|have to take

mcq.question: I’ll be late for work tomorrow. I ___ to the dentist.
mcq.full: I’ll be late for work tomorrow. I have to go to the dentist.
mcq.vi: Mai tôi sẽ đi làm muộn. Tôi phải đi nha sĩ.
mcq.expl:
have to / has to + infinitive = it is necessary, I am obliged to do it.
have to / has to + nguyên mẫu = cần phải, bắt buộc phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: have to go.
mcq.key: I’ll be late for work tomorrow. I ___ to the dentist.|have to go

mcq.question: Jane starts work at 7 o’clock, so she ___ up at 6.
mcq.full: Jane starts work at 7 o’clock, so she has to get up at 6.
mcq.vi: Jane bắt đầu làm lúc 7 giờ, nên cô ấy phải dậy lúc 6 giờ.
mcq.expl:
have to / has to + infinitive = it is necessary, I am obliged to do it.
have to / has to + nguyên mẫu = cần phải, bắt buộc phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: she → has to.
mcq.key: Jane starts work at 7 o’clock, so she ___ up at 6.|has to get

mcq.question: You ___ a test before you can get a driving licence.
mcq.full: You have to pass a test before you can get a driving licence.
mcq.vi: Bạn phải đỗ một bài thi trước khi được cấp bằng lái.
mcq.expl:
have to / has to + infinitive = it is necessary, I am obliged to do it.
have to / has to + nguyên mẫu = cần phải, bắt buộc phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: have to pass.
mcq.key: You ___ a test before you can get a driving licence.|have to pass

mcq.question: My eyes are not very good. I ___ glasses.
mcq.full: My eyes are not very good. I have to wear glasses.
mcq.vi: Mắt tôi không tốt lắm. Tôi phải đeo kính.
mcq.expl:
have to / has to + infinitive = it is necessary, I am obliged to do it.
have to / has to + nguyên mẫu = cần phải, bắt buộc phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: have to wear.
mcq.key: My eyes are not very good. I ___ glasses.|have to wear

mcq.question: At the end of the course all the students ___ a test.
mcq.full: At the end of the course all the students have to do a test.
mcq.vi: Cuối khóa tất cả học viên phải làm bài kiểm tra.
mcq.expl:
have to / has to + infinitive = it is necessary, I am obliged to do it.
have to / has to + nguyên mẫu = cần phải, bắt buộc phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: "all the students" → have to.
mcq.key: At the end of the course all the students ___ a test.|have to do

mcq.question: Sarah is studying literature. She ___ a lot of books.
mcq.full: Sarah is studying literature. She has to read a lot of books.
mcq.vi: Sarah học văn học. Cô ấy phải đọc rất nhiều sách.
mcq.expl:
have to / has to + infinitive = it is necessary, I am obliged to do it.
have to / has to + nguyên mẫu = cần phải, bắt buộc phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: she → has to read.
mcq.key: Sarah is studying literature. She ___ a lot of books.|has to read

mcq.full: Albert doesn’t understand much English. You have to speak very slowly to him.
mcq.vi: Albert không hiểu nhiều tiếng Anh. Bạn phải nói thật chậm với ông ấy.
mcq.expl:
have to / has to + infinitive = it is necessary, I am obliged to do it.
have to / has to + nguyên mẫu = cần phải, bắt buộc phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: have to speak.
mcq.key: Albert doesn’t understand much English. You ___ very slowly to him.|have to speak

mcq.question: Kate is often away from home. She ___ a lot in her job.
mcq.full: Kate is often away from home. She has to travel a lot in her job.
mcq.vi: Kate thường xa nhà. Cô ấy phải đi công tác nhiều.
mcq.expl:
have to / has to + infinitive = it is necessary, I am obliged to do it.
have to / has to + nguyên mẫu = cần phải, bắt buộc phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: has to travel.
mcq.key: Kate is often away from home. She ___ a lot in her job.|has to travel

mcq.question: In tennis you ___ the ball over the net.
mcq.full: In tennis you have to hit the ball over the net.
mcq.vi: Trong quần vợt bạn phải đánh bóng qua lưới.
mcq.expl:
have to / has to + infinitive = it is necessary, I am obliged to do it.
have to / has to + nguyên mẫu = cần phải, bắt buộc phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: have to hit.
mcq.key: In tennis you ___ the ball over the net.|have to hit

mcq.question: It’s late. I ___ now. I’ll see you tomorrow.
mcq.full: It’s late. I have to go now. I’ll see you tomorrow.
mcq.vi: Muộn rồi. Tôi phải đi đây. Mai gặp lại.
mcq.expl:
have to / has to + infinitive = it is necessary, I am obliged to do it.
have to / has to + nguyên mẫu = cần phải, bắt buộc phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Hiện tại → have to.
mcq.key: It’s late. I ___ now. I’ll see you tomorrow.|have to go

mcq.question: This train doesn’t go all the way to London. You ___ at Bristol.
mcq.full: This train doesn’t go all the way to London. You have to change at Bristol.
mcq.vi: Tàu này không chạy thẳng tới London. Bạn phải đổi tàu ở Bristol.
mcq.expl:
have to / has to + infinitive = it is necessary, I am obliged to do it.
have to / has to + nguyên mẫu = cần phải, bắt buộc phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: have to change.
mcq.key: This train doesn’t go all the way to London. You ___ at Bristol.|have to change

mcq.question: I was late for work yesterday. I ___ to the dentist.
mcq.full: I was late for work yesterday. I had to go to the dentist.
mcq.vi: Hôm qua tôi đi làm muộn. Tôi đã phải đi nha sĩ.
mcq.expl:
Past = had to + infinitive.
Quá khứ = had to + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Quá khứ → had to.
mcq.key: I was late for work yesterday. I ___ to the dentist.|had to go

mcq.question: We ___ home last night. There were no buses.
mcq.full: We had to walk home last night. There were no buses.
mcq.vi: Tối qua chúng tôi phải đi bộ về nhà. Không có xe buýt.
mcq.expl:
Past = had to + infinitive.
Quá khứ = had to + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Quá khứ → had to.
mcq.key: We ___ home last night. There were no buses.|had to walk

mcq.question: I went to the supermarket after work yesterday. I ___ some food.
mcq.full: I went to the supermarket after work yesterday. I had to buy some food.
mcq.vi: Hôm qua sau giờ làm tôi đến siêu thị. Tôi phải mua ít đồ ăn.
mcq.expl:
Past = had to + infinitive.
Quá khứ = had to + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Quá khứ → had to.
mcq.key: I went to the supermarket after work yesterday. I ___ some food.|had to buy

mcq.question: We did an exam yesterday. We ___ six questions out of ten.
mcq.full: We did an exam yesterday. We had to answer six questions out of ten.
mcq.vi: Hôm qua chúng tôi thi. Chúng tôi phải trả lời sáu trên mười câu hỏi.
mcq.expl:
Past = had to + infinitive.
Quá khứ = had to + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Quá khứ → had to.
mcq.key: We did an exam yesterday. We ___ six questions out of ten.|had to answer

mcq.question: What time ___ to the dentist tomorrow?
mcq.full: What time do you have to go to the dentist tomorrow?
mcq.vi: Mai mấy giờ bạn phải đi nha sĩ?
mcq.expl:
Questions: do/does/did + subject + have to …?
Câu hỏi: do/does/did + chủ ngữ + have to …?
Điểm ngữ pháp: do + you + have to.
mcq.key: What time ___ to the dentist tomorrow?|do you have to go

mcq.question: ___ Jane have to work on Sundays?
mcq.full: Does Jane have to work on Sundays?
mcq.vi: Jane có phải làm việc Chủ nhật không?
mcq.expl:
Questions: do/does/did + subject + have to …?
Câu hỏi: do/does/did + chủ ngữ + have to …?
Điểm ngữ pháp: Jane → Does … have to?
mcq.key: ___ Jane have to work on Sundays?|Does

mcq.question: Why ___ have to leave the party early?
mcq.full: Why did they have to leave the party early?
mcq.vi: Tại sao họ đã phải rời bữa tiệc sớm?
mcq.expl:
Questions: do/does/did + subject + have to …?
Câu hỏi: do/does/did + chủ ngữ + have to …?
Điểm ngữ pháp: Quá khứ → did + they + have to.
mcq.key: Why ___ have to leave the party early?|did they

mcq.question: George had to wait a long time. How long ___?
mcq.full: George had to wait a long time. How long did he have to wait?
mcq.vi: George phải đợi rất lâu. Anh ấy đã phải đợi bao lâu?
mcq.expl:
Questions: do/does/did + subject + have to …?
Câu hỏi: do/does/did + chủ ngữ + have to …?
Điểm ngữ pháp: did + he + have to.
mcq.key: George had to wait a long time. How long ___?|did he have to wait

mcq.question: Lisa has to go somewhere. Where ___?
mcq.full: Lisa has to go somewhere. Where does she have to go?
mcq.vi: Lisa phải đi đâu đó. Cô ấy phải đi đâu?
mcq.expl:
Questions: do/does/did + subject + have to …?
Câu hỏi: do/does/did + chủ ngữ + have to …?
Điểm ngữ pháp: does + she + have to.
mcq.key: Lisa has to go somewhere. Where ___?|does she have to go

mcq.question: We had to pay a lot of money. How much ___?
mcq.full: We had to pay a lot of money. How much did you have to pay?
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi phải trả rất nhiều tiền. Các bạn đã phải trả bao nhiêu?
mcq.expl:
Questions: do/does/did + subject + have to …?
Câu hỏi: do/does/did + chủ ngữ + have to …?
Điểm ngữ pháp: did + you + have to.
mcq.key: We had to pay a lot of money. How much ___?|did you have to pay

mcq.question: I have to do some work. What exactly ___?
mcq.full: I have to do some work. What exactly do you have to do?
mcq.vi: Tôi phải làm một số việc. Chính xác bạn phải làm gì?
mcq.expl:
Questions: do/does/did + subject + have to …?
Câu hỏi: do/does/did + chủ ngữ + have to …?
Điểm ngữ pháp: do + you + have to.
mcq.key: I have to do some work. What exactly ___?|do you have to do

mcq.question: I’m not working tomorrow, so I ___ up early.
mcq.full: I’m not working tomorrow, so I don’t have to get up early.
mcq.vi: Mai tôi không làm việc, nên tôi không phải dậy sớm.
mcq.expl:
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = it is not / was not necessary.
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = không cần (đã không cần) phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không cần → don’t have to.
mcq.key: I’m not working tomorrow, so I ___ up early.|don’t have to get

mcq.question: Ian ___ very hard. He’s got an easy job.
mcq.full: Ian doesn’t have to work very hard. He’s got an easy job.
mcq.vi: Ian không phải làm việc vất vả. Anh ấy có công việc nhàn.
mcq.expl:
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = it is not / was not necessary.
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = không cần (đã không cần) phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: he → doesn’t have to.
mcq.key: Ian ___ very hard. He’s got an easy job.|doesn’t have to work

mcq.question: We ___ very long for the bus – it came in a few minutes.
mcq.full: We didn’t have to wait very long for the bus – it came in a few minutes.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi không phải đợi xe buýt lâu – vài phút là xe đến.
mcq.expl:
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = it is not / was not necessary.
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = không cần (đã không cần) phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Quá khứ → didn’t have to.
mcq.key: We ___ very long for the bus – it came in a few minutes.|didn’t have to wait

mcq.question: Why are you going out? You ___ go out.
mcq.full: Why are you going out? You don’t have to go out.
mcq.vi: Sao bạn lại ra ngoài? Bạn không cần ra ngoài mà.
mcq.expl:
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = it is not / was not necessary.
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = không cần (đã không cần) phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: don’t have to.
mcq.key: Why are you going out? You ___ go out.|don’t have to

mcq.question: Why is Sue waiting? She ___ wait.
mcq.full: Why is Sue waiting? She doesn’t have to wait.
mcq.vi: Sao Sue lại đợi? Cô ấy không cần đợi.
mcq.expl:
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = it is not / was not necessary.
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = không cần (đã không cần) phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: she → doesn’t have to.
mcq.key: Why is Sue waiting? She ___ wait.|doesn’t have to

mcq.question: Why did you get up early? You ___ get up early.
mcq.full: Why did you get up early? You didn’t have to get up early.
mcq.vi: Sao bạn dậy sớm? Bạn đâu cần dậy sớm.
mcq.expl:
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = it is not / was not necessary.
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = không cần (đã không cần) phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Quá khứ → didn’t have to.
mcq.key: Why did you get up early? You ___ get up early.|didn’t have to

mcq.question: Why do you want to leave now? We ___ leave now.
mcq.full: Why do you want to leave now? We don’t have to leave now.
mcq.vi: Sao bạn muốn đi bây giờ? Chúng ta không cần đi bây giờ.
mcq.expl:
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = it is not / was not necessary.
don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to = không cần (đã không cần) phải làm.
Điểm ngữ pháp: don’t have to.
mcq.key: Why do you want to leave now? We ___ leave now.|don’t have to

mcq.question: Jessica won’t be at work this afternoon. She ___ to the doctor.
mcq.full: Jessica won’t be at work this afternoon. She has to go to the doctor.
mcq.vi: Chiều nay Jessica không đi làm. Cô ấy phải đi khám bác sĩ.
mcq.expl:
must or have to for your opinion; only have to for facts (not your opinion).
must hoặc have to cho ý kiến cá nhân; chỉ have to cho sự thật khách quan.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sự thật (không phải ý kiến) → has to.
mcq.key: Jessica won’t be at work this afternoon. She ___ to the doctor.|has to go

mcq.question: Jane isn’t well. She doesn’t want to go to the doctor, but I told her she ___ go.
mcq.full: Jane isn’t well. She doesn’t want to go to the doctor, but I told her she must go.
mcq.vi: Jane không khỏe. Cô ấy không muốn đi khám, nhưng tôi bảo cô ấy phải đi.
mcq.expl:
must or have to for your opinion; only have to for facts (not your opinion).
must hoặc have to cho ý kiến cá nhân; chỉ have to cho sự thật khách quan.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Ý kiến cá nhân → must.
mcq.key: Jane isn’t well. She doesn’t want to go to the doctor, but I told her she ___ go.|must

mcq.question: You can’t park your car here for nothing. You ___.
mcq.full: You can’t park your car here for nothing. You have to pay.
mcq.vi: Bạn không thể đỗ xe ở đây miễn phí. Bạn phải trả tiền.
mcq.expl:
must or have to for your opinion; only have to for facts (not your opinion).
must hoặc have to cho ý kiến cá nhân; chỉ have to cho sự thật khách quan.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Quy định (sự thật) → have to.
mcq.key: You can’t park your car here for nothing. You ___.|have to pay

mcq.question: I didn’t have any money with me last night, so I ___ some.
mcq.full: I didn’t have any money with me last night, so I had to borrow some.
mcq.vi: Tối qua tôi không mang tiền, nên tôi phải mượn một ít.
mcq.expl:
must or have to for your opinion; only have to for facts (not your opinion).
must hoặc have to cho ý kiến cá nhân; chỉ have to cho sự thật khách quan.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Quá khứ → had to.
mcq.key: I didn’t have any money with me last night, so I ___ some.|had to borrow

mcq.question: Paul is in a hurry. He ___ somebody in five minutes.
mcq.full: Paul is in a hurry. He has to meet somebody in five minutes.
mcq.vi: Paul đang vội. Năm phút nữa anh ấy phải gặp một người.
mcq.expl:
